tasks.subject: Task 0: Configuration, migration, and models skeleton
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `config.rbac` exists, the migration is registered behind the flag, and the two tables exist in the test DB.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `Plutonium.configuration.rbac.enabled` defaults to false.
- [ ] `Plutonium::Migrations.enabled_paths` includes `db/migrate/rbac` only when enabled.
- [ ] Test DB has `plutonium_rbac_roles` and `plutonium_rbac_role_assignments`.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/configuration_test.rb` → all pass

tasks.subject: Task 1: Permission, Matcher, registries, Catalog
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A catalog of every permission key, built from definitions (standard + custom actions), restricted fields, and hand-declared permissions, plus wildcard-aware matching.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `Matcher.grants?` handles exact, `*`, and `<resource>.*`, and treats wildcard keys being granted as requiring an equal-or-broader wildcard.
- [ ] Catalog has `blogging/post.{read,create,update,destroy,export}` and `blogging/post.publish` / `.archive` (custom actions from `Blogging::PostDefinition`), and excludes `blogging/post.new/show/edit`.
- [ ] Declared permissions (`Rbac.permission "reports.view"`) appear.
- [ ] `custom_actions_for(Blogging::Post)` includes `:publish`.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/catalog_test.rb test/plutonium/rbac/matcher_test.rb` (run each file separately if the runner takes one) → pass

See plan section 'Task 1: Permission, Matcher, registries, Catalog'.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Current, Role, RoleAssignment, escalation guard
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Persisted roles and assignments with key validation, tenant matching, and the "can't grant what you don't have" guard.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Unknown keys are rejected; wildcards are rejected unless `system_role`.
- [ ] `key` defaults from `name` and is unique per entity (including the global `nil` entity).
- [ ] With an actor resolver set, a role/assignment granting keys the actor lacks is invalid; a nil actor fails closed; no resolver (console/seeds) skips the guard.
- [ ] A tenant role cannot be assigned to a holder whose `rbac_entity` differs.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/role_test.rb` and `.../role_assignment_test.rb` → pass

See plan section 'Task 2: Current, Role, RoleAssignment, escalation guard'.

```json:metadata

```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Holder concern
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Any model can hold roles, with cached permission keys and a form-friendly `rbac_role_ids` that validates and saves with the holder.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `rbac_permission_keys` is the union of all roles' keys; one query per request (cache hit on repeat).
- [ ] `rbac_granted?` respects wildcards.
- [ ] `rbac_role_ids=` stages; invalid staged roles add errors on `:rbac_roles` and the save fails without touching assignments; a valid save adds/removes assignments and invalidates the cache.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/holder_test.rb` and `.../role_assignment_test.rb` → pass

See plan section 'Task 3: Holder concern'.

```json:metadata

```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Policy mixin (predicates and custom actions)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `include Plutonium::Rbac::Policy` makes the core predicates and custom-action rules permission-backed, without breaking delegation or `send_with_report`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `read?/create?/update?/destroy?/export_csv?` check `<resource>.<read|create|update|destroy|export>`.
- [ ] `index?/show?/new?/edit?/kanban_move?` still delegate (e.g. `edit?` follows `update?`).
- [ ] `publish?` resolves via `respond_to?` and checks `blogging/post.publish`; an explicit `publish?` that calls `super` combines both checks.
- [ ] `send_with_report(:nonexistent?)` still raises `NotImplementedError`.
- [ ] `granted?("reports.view")` works for hand-declared keys.
- [ ] No holder (resolver returns nil) denies everything.
- [ ] `Rbac::Policy.resource_class_for(Blogging::PostPolicy)` is `Blogging::Post`; for `OrgPortal::Blogging::PostPolicy` it is also `Blogging::Post`.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/policy_test.rb` → pass

See plan section 'Task 4: Policy mixin (predicates and custom actions)'.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/plutonium/rbac/policy.rb", "test/plutonium/rbac/policy_test.rb"], "verifyCommand": "bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/policy_test.rb", "acceptanceCriteria": ["core predicates map to keys", "delegation intact", "custom actions via respond_to", "unknown predicate raises", "nil holder denies"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Field-level permissions
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `rbac_restricted_attributes` hides ungranted fields from every `permitted_attributes_for_*`, including subclass overrides.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Without `.salary.read`, `salary` is missing from read/index/show/export lists; with it, present.
- [ ] Without `.salary.write`, `salary` is missing from create/update/new/edit lists.
- [ ] A subclass that overrides `permitted_attributes_for_index` directly is still filtered.
- [ ] Restricted fields appear in the catalog as `<resource>.salary.read` / `.write`.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/policy_attribute_filter_test.rb` → pass

See plan section 'Task 5: Field-level permissions'.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/plutonium/rbac/policy/attribute_filter.rb", "lib/plutonium/rbac/policy.rb", "test/plutonium/rbac/policy_attribute_filter_test.rb", "test/plutonium/rbac/catalog_test.rb"], "verifyCommand": "bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/policy_attribute_filter_test.rb", "acceptanceCriteria": ["read side filtered", "write side filtered", "subclass overrides filtered", "field keys in catalog"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Controller wiring (actor) and system-role sync
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Requests set the escalation-guard actor automatically; `rake plutonium:rbac:sync` upserts code-declared system roles.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] With RBAC enabled, a request through any Plutonium controller has `Rbac::Current.actor_resolver` set, resolving to `Rbac.holder_for(user: current_user, entity_scope:)`.
- [ ] With RBAC disabled, nothing is set.
- [ ] Sync creates `system_role: true` global roles, updates them on re-run, never duplicates.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/sync_test.rb` → pass

See plan section 'Task 6: Controller wiring (actor) and system-role sync'.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/plutonium/core/controllers/authorizable.rb", "lib/plutonium/railtie.rb", "lib/plutonium/rbac/sync.rb", "lib/tasks/rbac.rake", "test/plutonium/rbac/sync_test.rb", "test/plutonium/rbac/controller_actor_test.rb"], "verifyCommand": "bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/sync_test.rb", "acceptanceCriteria": ["actor resolver installed when enabled", "sync idempotent", "rake task listed"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Role resource (definition, policy, permission grid UI)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `register_resource ::Plutonium::Rbac::Role` gives a working, RBAC-gated management UI with a grouped permission picker.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Role policy scope: global roles + current tenant's roles in a tenant portal; only global roles outside one; never another tenant's.
- [ ] `update?/destroy?` false for system roles and for roles from another scope (e.g. a global role seen from a tenant portal).
- [ ] The form renders one checkbox per catalog key, named `<param>[permissions][]`, with a blank hidden input, grouped by resource, checked state reflecting the record.
- [ ] The Stimulus controller is registered as `rbac-permissions`; group and per-action toggles work.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/role_policy_test.rb` and the component test → pass; `yarn build` succeeds.

See plan section 'Task 7: Role resource (definition, policy, permission grid UI)'.

tasks.subject: Task 8: Invite integration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Roles chosen at invite time attach to the pending invite and move to the membership on acceptance, atomically.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] An invite model including `Plutonium::Rbac::Invite` is a holder (`rbac_role_ids=` works, escalation guard applies).
- [ ] `accept_for_user!` moves the invite's assignments to the membership `create_membership_for` returns; the invite has none afterwards.
- [ ] If membership creation raises, assignments stay on the invite (transaction rolls back).
- [ ] `Plutonium::Rbac::InviteUser` adds a `rbac_role_ids` attribute and passes it through `additional_invite_attributes`.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/rbac/invite_test.rb` → pass

See plan section 'Task 8: Invite integration'.


tasks.subject: Task 10: `pu:rbac:install` generator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One command enables RBAC, wires holders and the policy, writes the initializer, and connects the Role resource to a portal.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `config.rbac.enabled = true` lands in `config/initializers/plutonium.rb`.
- [ ] `config/initializers/rbac.rb` has a holder resolver built from `--holders` and stub `owner`/`member` system roles.
- [ ] Each holder model gets `include Plutonium::Rbac::Holder`; `Class:assoc` holders also get `def rbac_entity = assoc`.
- [ ] The `--policy` class file gets `include Plutonium::Rbac::Policy`.
- [ ] With `--dest=<portal>`: a `RbacRolesController` (`controller_for ::Plutonium::Rbac::Role`, entity merged into params) and `register_resource ::Plutonium::Rbac::Role` in routes. `--skip-portal` skips both.
- [ ] It logs reminders to run `db:migrate` and `plutonium:rbac:sync`.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/generators/rbac_install_generator_test.rb` → pass (stage `test/dummy` changes first, see Ground rules)

See plan section 'Task 10: `pu:rbac:install` generator'.

tasks.subject: Task 11: Dummy app integration (generators-first)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Exercise RBAC end to end in `org_portal` with a new `hr` package: custom tenant role can run a custom action but not destroy, and a restricted field is hidden.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Only `Hr::*` policies use RBAC (`--policy=Hr::ResourcePolicy`); the existing dummy suite is unaffected.
- [ ] Request test: a member with a tenant role granting `hr/employee.read` + `hr/employee.promote` sees the index, can run `promote`, gets denied on destroy, and doesn't see `salary`. Adding `hr/employee.salary.read` shows it.
- [ ] A member can create a tenant role in `/org/:id/rbac_roles` with the permission grid (form posts `permissions[]`); the role saves with the current org as entity.
- [ ] Escalation: that member cannot create a role containing a key they lack (422 / form error).

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/integration/rbac/org_portal_rbac_test.rb` → pass; then the full `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 rake test` → no new failures

See plan section 'Task 11: Dummy app integration (generators-first)'.

tasks.subject: Task 12: Docs, skills, experimental template
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Document RBAC for developers and AI assistants, and offer it in the experimental app template.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Guide opens with `::: warning Experimental`, covers: enabling and installing, key format, default predicates table, custom actions and `super`, restricted fields, system roles and sync, tenant roles and the escalation guard, invites, testing helper, non-goals.
- [ ] Every code sample is checked against the implementation (CLAUDE.md "Verify every code sample"). Run at least: `cd test/dummy && RAILS_ENV=test bin/rails runner 'p Plutonium::Rbac::Catalog.keys.grep(/hr\//)'` via the appraisal env and paste real keys.
- [ ] No em dashes; voice rules followed.
- [ ] `experimental.rb` mentions RBAC as needing holders, so it prints the command to run rather than running it (a fresh app has no membership model yet).
- [ ] `yarn docs:build` passes.

**Verify:** `yarn docs:build` → success; `grep -n "—" docs/guides/rbac.md` → no output

See plan section 'Task 12: Docs, skills, experimental template'.
